title: Three careers at Nutrien you may not have considered
summary: Explore careers in agriculture at Nutrien and meet the people working in skilled trades, transportation and operations across our business.
body_markdown:
What does a career in agriculture look like?


It may be different than you think.


It might mean keeping massive equipment running at a potash operation. Spending the day on the road helping customers get what they need. Or solving complex technical problems at a nitrogen facility.


Those careers may look very different, but each is part of the work happening every day at Nutrien. Three new videos take you inside those roles, introducing the employees who do the work and sharing, in their own words, what the job involves, what keeps them engaged and what they’ve found here.


Take a look inside three careers you may not have considered.


### Keeping things moving


At Nutrien’s Lanigan potash operation in Saskatchewan, Heavy Duty and Industrial Mechanics help keep critical equipment running safely and reliably.


Jordan Elke and Chris Solar talk about the people they rely on, opportunities to grow and the ability to build a career while still making time for life outside work.


[Explore mechanic careers at Nutrien](https://jobs.nutrien.com/North-America/search/?q=potash&locationsearch=&searchResultView=LIST&locale=en_US&utm_source=customcampaign&utm_campaign=PotashJobsLP2026)


**


### More than driving a truck


In Saskatchewan, home to Nutrien's six potash operations and corporate headquarters, the company invests in school nutrition and related community partnerships across Saskatoon, Regina, and several rural communities. These programs help ensure students have access to nutritious food during the school year and throughout the summer months when school meal programs may not be available.


[Explore CDL Driver opportunities at Nutrien](https://jobs.nutrien.com/North-America/search/?q=driver&locationsearch=&searchResultView=LIST&markerViewed=&carouselIndex=&facetFilters=%7B%22division_obj%22%3A%5B%22Cornbelt+Region%22%5D%7D&pageNumber=0&locale=en_US&utm_source=customcampaign&utm_campaign=CDL_Driver_Campaign)


**


### Solving problems together


At Nutrien’s Geismar facility in Louisiana, Electrical & Instrumentation professionals support work ranging from design and installation to commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting.


“The teamwork, the relationships that I’ve built in the last year have been outstanding,” Aaron Churaman says in the video.


[Explore engineering careers at Nutrien](https://jobs.nutrien.com/North-America/search/?q=engineer&locationsearch=&searchResultView=LIST&locale=en_US&utm_source=SpotCareerBranding&utm_campaign=Engineering_Recruitment_NA)


### Find your place at Nutrien


A career in agriculture can take more forms than you might expect.


Whether you’re interested in working with equipment, getting behind the wheel, solving technical challenges or exploring something entirely different, there may be an opportunity at Nutrien you haven’t considered yet.


[Explore career opportunities across Nutrien](https://jobs.nutrien.com/)
